carrierPolicy: Each known public role has two exact original literal byte runs around one uniquely owned complete __NEXT_DATA__ JSON slot. Its entire35-field job must equal the same original current native API object; all non-job model/query/company/build data match the reviewed original. All other original DOM, attributes, ancestor/mount controls, raw inline code/styles, external declarations and metadata are exact. No other text/attribute span is ignored. Outer-copy changes fail closed rather than being normalized; scope is finite known original carriers, not an arbitrary/future renderer.
criteriaPolicy: Keep the complete original rich description and all35 native fields. Constrain current emitted rich markup to reviewed tags/attributes, preserve ordinary text; unsupported media, attachments, new criteria/schema fields or screening-question types require review and cannot disappear. Native API/status/country/date and any selected same-role public data must agree. Data completeness never means CSS/dependency/render/application completeness.
